lessonTitle: 34. Volumes of the pyramid and the truncated pyramid
lessonTitleEnglish: Volumes of the pyramid and the truncated pyramid
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 12 mathematics textbooks (advanced stream)

stages.headline: The volume of a pyramid is V = ⅓ S(base) · h.
stages.headlineEnglish: The volume of a pyramid is V = ⅓ S(base) · h.

stages.headline: Example: a regular square pyramid with base side 6 and h = 4 has V = ⅓ · 36 · 4 = 48.
stages.headlineEnglish: Example: a regular square pyramid with base side 6 and h = 4 has V = ⅓ · 36 · 4 = 48.

stages.headline: A truncated pyramid has volume V = ⅓ h (S₁ + √(S₁S₂) + S₂), where S₁ and S₂ are the base areas.
stages.headlineEnglish: A truncated pyramid has volume V = ⅓ h (S₁ + √(S₁S₂) + S₂), where S₁ and S₂ are the base areas.
